title: Polish Potato Pancakes
description: A classic Eastern European dish made with grated potatoes and served with a side of velvety sour cream. Crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside, these pancakes are a delicious accompaniment to any meal.
instructions: Grate the potatoes and squeeze out as much liquid as possible.
In a large bowl, combine the grated potatoes, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add the egg and mix well.
Heat a large frying pan with about 1/2 inch of oil over medium-high heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the potato mixture into the pan and flatten slightly.
Cook for about 4-5 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
Serve hot with a dollop of velvety sour cream.
If using polish sausage, cook according to package instructions and serve on top of the pancakes.
